description: Every in-scope verb MUST end stderr with `done in <formatted>` (`<N>ms` under a second, `<N.N>s` under a minute, `<M>m <S>s` beyond), and when its `--json` output is a top-level OBJECT that document MUST also carry a top-level `elapsedMs` integer. `sm refresh` is chosen because it exercises both halves at once: the stderr line and the in-document field. Verbs whose schema already expresses wall-clock under a nested field (`scan-result.schema.json` → `stats.durationMs`) are exempt from the top-level field by contract, and informational verbs (`sm version`, `sm config list`) are exempt from the line entirely.
